45: 	@Override
46: 	public void handle(AnnotationValues<StandardException> annotation, Annotation ast, EclipseNode annotationNode) {

48: 		
49: 		EclipseNode typeNode = annotationNode.up();
50: 		if (!isClass(typeNode)) {

52: 			return;
53: 		}
54: 		
55: 		TypeDeclaration classDef = (TypeDeclaration) typeNode.get();
56: 		if (classDef.superclass == null) {
57: 			annotationNode.addError("@StandardException requires that you extend a Throwable type");
58: 			return;
59: 		}
60: 		
61: 		AccessLevel access = annotation.getInstance().access();
62: 		
63: 		generateNoArgsConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
64: 		generateMsgOnlyConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
65: 		generateCauseOnlyConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
66: 		generateFullConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
67: 	}

69: 	private void generateNoArgsConstructor(EclipseNode typeNode, AccessLevel level, EclipseNode source) {
70: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;
71: 		int pS = source.get().sourceStart, pE = source.get().sourceEnd;
72: 		
73: 		ExplicitConstructorCall explicitCall = new ExplicitConstructorCall(ExplicitConstructorCall.This);
74: 		explicitCall.arguments = new Expression[] {new NullLiteral(pS, pE), new NullLiteral(pS, pE)};
75: 		ConstructorDeclaration constructor = createConstructor(level, typeNode, false, false, source, explicitCall, null);
76: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constructor);
77: 	}
78: 	
79: 	private void generateMsgOnlyConstructor(EclipseNode typeNode, AccessLevel level, EclipseNode source) {
80: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode, String.class) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;
81: 		int pS = source.get().sourceStart, pE = source.get().sourceEnd;
82: 		long p = (long) pS << 32 | pE;
83: 		
84: 		ExplicitConstructorCall explicitCall = new ExplicitConstructorCall(ExplicitConstructorCall.This);
85: 		explicitCall.arguments = new Expression[] {new SingleNameReference(MESSAGE, p), new NullLiteral(pS, pE)};
86: 		ConstructorDeclaration constructor = createConstructor(level, typeNode, true, false, source, explicitCall, null);
87: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constructor);
88: 	}

90: 	private void generateCauseOnlyConstructor(EclipseNode typeNode, AccessLevel level, EclipseNode source) {
91: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode, Throwable.class) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;
92: 		int pS = source.get().sourceStart, pE = source.get().sourceEnd;
93: 		long p = (long) pS << 32 | pE;
94: 		
95: 		ExplicitConstructorCall explicitCall = new ExplicitConstructorCall(ExplicitConstructorCall.This);
96: 		Expression causeNotNull = new EqualExpression(new SingleNameReference(CAUSE, p), new NullLiteral(pS, pE), OperatorIds.NOT_EQUAL);
97: 		MessageSend causeDotGetMessage = new MessageSend();
98: 		causeDotGetMessage.sourceStart = pS; causeDotGetMessage.sourceEnd = pE;
99: 		causeDotGetMessage.receiver = new SingleNameReference(CAUSE, p);
100: 		causeDotGetMessage.selector = GET_MESSAGE;
101: 		Expression messageExpr = new ConditionalExpression(causeNotNull, causeDotGetMessage, new NullLiteral(pS, pE));
102: 		explicitCall.arguments = new Expression[] {messageExpr, new SingleNameReference(CAUSE, p)};
103: 		ConstructorDeclaration constructor = createConstructor(level, typeNode, false, true, source, explicitCall, null);
104: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constructor);
105: 	}

107: 	private void generateFullConstructor(EclipseNode typeNode, AccessLevel level, EclipseNode source) {
108: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode, String.class, Throwable.class) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;
109: 		int pS = source.get().sourceStart, pE = source.get().sourceEnd;
110: 		long p = (long) pS << 32 | pE;
111: 		
112: 		ExplicitConstructorCall explicitCall = new ExplicitConstructorCall(ExplicitConstructorCall.Super);
113: 		explicitCall.arguments = new Expression[] {new SingleNameReference(MESSAGE, p)};
114: 		Expression causeNotNull = new EqualExpression(new SingleNameReference(CAUSE, p), new NullLiteral(pS, pE), OperatorIds.NOT_EQUAL);
115: 		MessageSend causeDotInitCause = new MessageSend();
116: 		causeDotInitCause.sourceStart = pS; causeDotInitCause.sourceEnd = pE;
117: 		causeDotInitCause.receiver = new SuperReference(pS, pE);
118: 		causeDotInitCause.selector = INIT_CAUSE;
119: 		causeDotInitCause.arguments = new Expression[] {new SingleNameReference(CAUSE, p)};
120: 		IfStatement ifs = new IfStatement(causeNotNull, causeDotInitCause, pS, pE);
121: 		ConstructorDeclaration constructor = createConstructor(level, typeNode, true, true, source, explicitCall, ifs);
122: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constructor);
123: 	}

125: 	/**

127: 	 */

129: 		node = upToTypeNode(node);
130: 		
131: 		if (node != null && node.get() instanceof TypeDeclaration) {
132: 			TypeDeclaration typeDecl = (TypeDeclaration) node.get();
133: 			if (typeDecl.methods != null) for (AbstractMethodDeclaration def : typeDecl.methods) {

135: 					if ((def.bits & ASTNode.IsDefaultConstructor) != 0) continue;
136: 					if (!paramsMatch(node, def.arguments, paramTypes)) continue;

138: 				}
139: 			}
140: 		}
141: 		
142: 		return MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS;
143: 	}

145: 	private static boolean paramsMatch(EclipseNode node, Argument[] a, Class<?>[] b) {
146: 		if (a == null) return b == null || b.length == 0;
147: 		if (b == null) return a.length == 0;
148: 		if (a.length != b.length) return false;
149: 		
150: 		for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
151: 			if (!typeMatches(b[i], node, a[i].type)) return false;
152: 		}
153: 		return true;
154: 	}

159: 	public static Annotation[] createConstructorProperties(ASTNode source, boolean msgParam, boolean causeParam) {
160: 		if (!msgParam && !causeParam) return null;
161: 		
162: 		int pS = source.sourceStart, pE = source.sourceEnd;
163: 		long p = (long) pS << 32 | pE;
164: 		long[] poss = new long[3];
165: 		Arrays.fill(poss, p);
166: 		
167: 		QualifiedTypeReference constructorPropertiesType = new QualifiedTypeReference(JAVA_BEANS_CONSTRUCTORPROPERTIES, poss);
168: 		setGeneratedBy(constructorPropertiesType, source);
169: 		SingleMemberAnnotation ann = new SingleMemberAnnotation(constructorPropertiesType, pS);
170: 		ann.declarationSourceEnd = pE;
171: 		
172: 		ArrayInitializer fieldNames = new ArrayInitializer();
173: 		fieldNames.sourceStart = pS;
174: 		fieldNames.sourceEnd = pE;
175: 		fieldNames.expressions = new Expression[(msgParam && causeParam) ? 2 : 1];
176: 		
177: 		int ctr = 0;
178: 		if (msgParam) {
179: 			fieldNames.expressions[ctr] = new StringLiteral(MESSAGE, pS, pE, 0);
180: 			setGeneratedBy(fieldNames.expressions[ctr], source);
181: 			ctr++;
182: 		}
183: 		if (causeParam) {
184: 			fieldNames.expressions[ctr] = new StringLiteral(CAUSE, pS, pE, 0);
185: 			setGeneratedBy(fieldNames.expressions[ctr], source);
186: 			ctr++;
187: 		}
188: 		
189: 		ann.memberValue = fieldNames;
190: 		setGeneratedBy(ann, source);
191: 		setGeneratedBy(ann.memberValue, source);
192: 		return new Annotation[] { ann };
193: 	}
194: 	
195: 	@SuppressWarnings("deprecation") public static ConstructorDeclaration createConstructor(AccessLevel level, EclipseNode typeNode, boolean msgParam, boolean causeParam, EclipseNode sourceNode, ExplicitConstructorCall explicitCall, Statement extra) {
196: 		ASTNode source = sourceNode.get();
197: 		TypeDeclaration typeDeclaration = ((TypeDeclaration) typeNode.get());
198: 		int pS = source.sourceStart, pE = source.sourceEnd;
199: 		long p = (long) pS << 32 | pE;
200: 		
201: 		boolean addConstructorProperties;
202: 		if ((!msgParam && !causeParam) || isLocalType(typeNode)) {
203: 			addConstructorProperties = false;
204: 		} else {
205: 			Boolean v = typeNode.getAst().readConfiguration(ConfigurationKeys.ANY_CONSTRUCTOR_ADD_CONSTRUCTOR_PROPERTIES);
206: 			addConstructorProperties = v != null ? v.booleanValue() :
207: 				Boolean.FALSE.equals(typeNode.getAst().readConfiguration(ConfigurationKeys.ANY_CONSTRUCTOR_SUPPRESS_CONSTRUCTOR_PROPERTIES));
208: 		}
209: 		
210: 		ConstructorDeclaration constructor = new ConstructorDeclaration(((CompilationUnitDeclaration) typeNode.top().get()).compilationResult);
211: 		
212: 		constructor.modifiers = toEclipseModifier(level);
213: 		constructor.selector = typeDeclaration.name;
214: 		constructor.thrownExceptions = null;
215: 		constructor.typeParameters = null;
216: 		constructor.bits |= ECLIPSE_DO_NOT_TOUCH_FLAG;
217: 		constructor.bodyStart = constructor.declarationSourceStart = constructor.sourceStart = pS;
218: 		constructor.bodyEnd = constructor.declarationSourceEnd = constructor.sourceEnd = pE;
219: 		constructor.arguments = null;
220: 		
221: 		List<Argument> params = new ArrayList<Argument>();
222: 		
223: 		if (msgParam) {
224: 			TypeReference typeRef = new QualifiedTypeReference(TypeConstants.JAVA_LANG_STRING, new long[] {p, p, p});
225: 			Argument parameter = new Argument(MESSAGE, p, typeRef, Modifier.FINAL);
226: 			params.add(parameter);
227: 		}
228: 		if (causeParam) {
229: 			TypeReference typeRef = new QualifiedTypeReference(TypeConstants.JAVA_LANG_THROWABLE, new long[] {p, p, p});
230: 			Argument parameter = new Argument(CAUSE, p, typeRef, Modifier.FINAL);
231: 			params.add(parameter);
232: 		}
233: 		
234: 		explicitCall.sourceStart = pS;
235: 		explicitCall.sourceEnd = pE;
236: 		constructor.constructorCall = explicitCall;
237: 		constructor.statements = extra != null ? new Statement[] {extra} : null;
238: 		constructor.arguments = params.isEmpty() ? null : params.toArray(new Argument[0]);
239: 		
240: 		Annotation[] constructorProperties = null;
241: 		if (addConstructorProperties) constructorProperties = createConstructorProperties(source, msgParam, causeParam);
242: 		constructor.annotations = copyAnnotations(source, constructorProperties);
243: 		constructor.traverse(new SetGeneratedByVisitor(source), typeDeclaration.scope);
244: 		return constructor;
245: 	}
